$comment: Airtable configuration of the automation that runs cct-triage-compute. The script itself is NOT here: it is the build output airtable/cct/dist/automations/cct-triage-compute.js (npm run cct:build), pasted by hand into the Run a script action. Keep this file in sync when the automation is changed in Airtable. Story MapKMigGon38571.

automation.name: command_center_triages · compute · hourly
automation.description: MapKMigGon38571. Every hour, computes the triage values for every command_center_tasks row (owner, stale state, suggested lane, delegation eligibility, cross-source identity) and writes them to command_center_triages, one row per task. Starts in dry-run mode (dryRun = yes): it plans and logs but writes nothing. Change the input to dryRun = no to write.

action.description: Reads the one active row of cct_triage_configs, the team_members roster, all command_center_tasks, the existing command_center_triages rows, dev_tickets (Linear issue ids) and approvals (linked invoices and follow-ups). Checks that every field it needs exists and that the config is valid; if not, it stops and logs a triage_data_issue event in priority_events. Otherwise it plans a 1:1 sync (create a triage row for each new task, update only the values that changed, mark rows closed when the task is closed and orphan when the task disappeared, report duplicate rows; it never deletes). With dryRun = yes it writes nothing and only logs a '[dry run]' triage_compute event with the counts. With dryRun = no it writes in batches of 50 within a 22 second budget, logs one triage_compute event and one triage_data_issue event per issue type, and stamps last_run_at, last_run_status and last_run_summary on the active cct_triage_configs row. It never writes command_center_tasks or task_lanes.

inputVariables.name: dryRun
inputVariables.note: Anything other than "no" is treated as yes.

outputsNotDeclared.name: message
outputsNotDeclared.note: The script also sets output 'message' on validation_failed paths, but it is not declared in the outputs above. Declare it as string if you want to see it in the run output.
